params.body:
## What

A signed `POST /internal/accounts`, next to the existing update and delete routes and checked with the same signature (method, path, timestamp, body; at most five minutes old). It lets editorial make a test account on gentells.com from the Observatory for a prospect or a client who should try Gentells.

- Takes `name`, `email`, `plan`, `trial_days` (0 to 90), optional `by` and `note`.
- Refuses with 409 an address that already has an account (case-insensitive), so an existing account is never taken over.
- Creates the account with a random password nobody knows, sets plan and trial with `forceFill` (billing fields stay out of mass assignment), marks it with `created_by_editorial_at` and `created_by_editorial` (who asked), and writes a `created` line to `account_changes`.
- Answers 201 with the account, a set-password `link`, `link_expires_at` and `mailed`.
- `GET /internal/accounts` now carries `created_by_editorial_at` and `created_by_editorial` for every account.

## How the link works

The link is the existing password reset page (`/reset-password/{token}`), with a token from a second password broker, `invites`, that lives 7 days and has its own table (`password_invite_tokens`). Keeping it in its own table means ordinary reset links keep their one hour: a week-long broker on the shared table would have stretched every reset token to a week. `PasswordResetController::reset` tries the normal broker first and the `invites` broker only when that token was not it. Setting a password through either link also removes any open set-password link, so it does not stay valid for the rest of its week.

The same link goes out as mail (`PasswordResetLink` with `invite: true`, subject "Your Gentells account is ready", view `mail/set-password`) when a mailer that really sends is configured. The log mailer does not count as sent, the same rule `FormController::notifyTeam` follows, and the answer says `mailed: false` so editorial knows to share the link. No password passes through the Observatory.

## Deploy

One migration: `2026_10_23_090000_users_made_by_editorial` adds two nullable columns to `users` and creates `password_invite_tokens`. Forge runs `php artisan migrate --force` on deploy; if it does not on this site, run it once after the merge.

## Tests

- `tests/Feature/InternalAccountsTest.php`: six new tests: signature required; account made with plan, trial, marker, change line, week-long link and mail; existing address refused; log mailer reports `mailed: false` and sends nothing; the link sets the first password and signs in three days later and works once; the link is dead after eight days.
- `php artisan test tests/Feature/InternalAccountsTest.php tests/Feature/PasswordResetTest.php`: 16 passed.
- Full suite: 468 tests, 467 passed. The one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which also fails on unmodified `main` in a git worktree (it reads the checkout's `.git`).
- `vendor/bin/pint --test`: passed.

Closes Trendwolves/gentells-site#223

params.title: Make a test account from the Observatory and share a set-password link
